name: My Bully is My Lover
source:
You will play as the MC who has an experience of being bullied by three girls during high school. Fought your way through heaven and hell just to change your physical appearance, and one day swore that you will get your revenge. However, after reaching adulthood, you realized that taking revenge is just a waste of time and decided to just move on with life. One day, your landlady put the other rooms in your house for rent. Without your knowledge, those three girls are the one moving in. Soon, You will discover something that will change your life forever.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/NiiChan029]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演主人公。他在高中时曾遭到三个女生的欺凌，为了改变外貌吃尽苦头，并一度发誓要报复她们。然而成年后，他意识到报复只是浪费时间，于是决定放下过去，继续生活。一天，女房东将你住处的其他房间出租了出去。而你毫不知情的是，搬进来的正是当年的那三个女生。很快，你就会发现一件足以永远改变人生的事。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/NiiChan029]Patreon[/url]]
